changelog.message: new op for real-time 2D human facial landmark and orientation tracking using macOS native Apple Vision neural framework
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Tracks 2D human facial landmarks, bounding boxes, and head orientation in real-time from an input WebGL texture using macOS Apple Vision neural frameworks.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Starts or stops the native Swift HumanFace sidecar process.

ports.name: Render
ports.text: Trigger render loop to process the incoming texture.

ports.name: Texture
ports.text: WebGL Texture containing the human subject's face to track.

ports.name: Faces Array
ports.text: An array of detected faces containing confidence, bounding box, roll/yaw/pitch angles, and detailed landmark point groups (faceContour, leftEye, rightEye, eyebrows, nose, lips, pupils, etc.).

ports.name: Detected Faces
ports.text: Total number of faces currently tracked in the active frame.

ports.name: On Faces Detected
ports.text: Trigger fired every time a new set of facial landmarks is received.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native 2D face tracking sidecar process is running.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the Swift sidecar process.
